critical_code_review_comments: httpOnly cookie auth migration verified working correctly:
1. Backend login (server.py lines 481-524) sets httpOnly cookie with correct attributes
2. Backend get_current_user (lines 341-361) reads cookie if no Authorization header
4. Frontend no longer uses localStorage for auth tokens
5. Cookie path=/api ensures cookie is sent only to API routes
6. SameSite=none + Secure allows cross-origin cookie sending
7. Logout properly deletes the auth_token cookie
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 verified the httpOnly cookie-based auth migration fix. The P0 bug (production login 'error de autenticación') was caused by stale static_frontend build using localStorage while backend used cookies. Fix confirmed working: (1) Login sets httpOnly cookie, (2) Session persists across page refresh, (3) All protected routes work with cookie auth, (4) Logout clears cookie. Both admin and developer accounts work correctly.
